title: 第13章 救人与杀人第14章 筑基期之威
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
旁系区域深处，一处偏僻的凡人小院前。
本就破败的木门在蛮力撞击下“咔嚓”脆响，碎成无数木屑四射飞溅。
“嘿嘿，小娘子，躲在地窖里有什么用？薄薄一层黄土，连世俗的武林高手都瞒不过，还想瞒过老子的灵目术？”
灰袍三角眼的刘家子弟迈步进院，浑身散发着炼气七层的法力波动。
他倒提着一柄滴血的下品法器飞剑，在青石地面上拖出一道刺目的血痕。
双眼闪烁着微弱的术法光芒，在灵目术的视野中，干草下的泥土里正散发着四个清晰的气血红斑。
“撕拉——”
他用剑尖挑开干草，露出下方的厚木地窖门。
“给老子滚出来！”
他狞笑一声，运足法力猛地一脚踹去。
“砰！”
木板四分五裂，地窖口顿时暴露。
狭小的地窖内，一对中年夫妇死死护住身后两道身影。
林小虎死死攥着一柄锈柴刀，眼中满是惊恐；
少年的身后，则是姐姐林小婉，她清丽脱俗的面容上挂满了泪水。
“渊哥儿明明提醒过我们的……都怪我，舍不得家里的灵田和祖屋……”
父亲林大山浑身颤抖，老泪纵横地低声呜咽。
两日前，林小婉带来林渊的提醒：“这几日不要靠近前山，若是可以，尽早离开林家山。”
可林大山夫妇只当是年轻人的胡言乱语，并未在意。
直到今夜阵法破裂、前山轰鸣，他们才如梦初醒，却已被陈、刘两家联军彻底困死在山中，只能躲进这地窖，祈求能逃过仙师的毒手。

“我跟你们拼了！”
眼看那名面相淫邪的刘家子弟探头进来，林小虎再也按捺不住。
他怒吼一声，举起柴刀便要冲上去。
“小虎！不要啊！”
林大山夫妇吓得魂飞魄散，将儿子死死按在泥地上。
“仙师饶命！我儿子年幼不懂事，求仙师放过他！家里的金银全在这里，都给您！”
林大山跪在泥水里，对着上方疯狂磕头，额头上瞬间一片血肉模糊。
“金银？世俗的黄白之物，也配拿来糊弄本仙师？”
地窖上方，刘家子弟眼中满是嫌恶。
他连看都懒得看那两个老东西一眼，目光落在林小婉那张清丽绝伦的面容上，心头邪火瞬间升腾：
“啧啧，没看出来，凡人堆里还能出这么个水灵的雏儿。带回去当个侍妾玩物，倒是不错。”
他淫笑连连，右手一扬，一缕灰色法力化作虚幻的气手，朝着林小婉抓去。
林小婉看着不断放大的巨手，绝望地闭上了双眼。
脑海中，突兀地浮现出两日前林渊离去时的背影。
“渊哥……”
然而，就在那只法力巨手即将触及林小婉衣角的刹那。
“嗡——！”
content_en:
Deep in the side area, in front of a remote mortal courtyard.
The already dilapidated wooden door clicked under the brute force impact, shattering into countless sawdust and flying everywhere.
"Hey, little lady, what's the use of hiding in the cellar? Even the worldly martial arts masters can't hide it with a thin layer of loess, and you want to hide it from me with my spiritual eye skills?"
The Liu family disciples in gray robes and triangular eyes stepped into the courtyard, exuding the mana fluctuations of the seventh level of Qi refining.
He held a flying sword, a low-grade magic weapon dripping with blood, and dragged a dazzling blood mark on the bluestone ground.
His eyes shone with a faint magical light. In the field of vision of the spiritual eye technique, four clear red spots of energy and blood were exuding in the soil under the hay.
"Tear-"
He used the tip of his sword to part the hay, revealing the thick wooden cellar door beneath.
"Get out of here!"
He laughed ferociously and used all his magic power to kick him away.
"Bang!"
The wooden planks were torn apart, and the cellar entrance was immediately exposed.
In the small cellar, a middle-aged couple tightly protected the two figures behind them.
Lin Xiaohu clutched a rusty hatchet tightly, his eyes filled with fear;
Behind the young man was his sister Lin Xiaowan, her elegant and refined face was covered with tears.
"Brother Yuan clearly reminded us... It's all my fault that I can't bear to part with my family's spiritual field and ancestral home..."
Father Lin Dashan was shaking all over and whimpering softly with tears streaming down his face.
Two days ago, Lin Xiaowan brought a reminder from Lin Yuan: "Don't go near Qianshan these days. If possible, leave Linjiashan as soon as possible."
But Lin Dashan and his wife only regarded it as the nonsense of young people and did not pay attention to it.
It wasn't until the formation broke down and the front mountain roared tonight that they woke up from a dream, but they were completely trapped in the mountain by the Chen and Liu coalition forces. They could only hide in this cellar and pray to escape the poisonous hands of the immortal master.
"I'll fight you!"
Seeing the lewd-looking member of the Liu family peeking his head in, Lin Xiaohu could no longer hold himself back.
He roared angrily, raised his hatchet and rushed forward.
"Xiaohu! No!"
Lin Dashan and his wife were so frightened that they pinned their son to the dirt.
"Master Immortal, have mercy on me! My son is young and ignorant, I beg Immortal Master to let him go! All the gold and silver in the family are here, all for you!"
Lin Dashan knelt in the muddy water, kowtowing crazily to the top, and his forehead was instantly bloody.
"Gold and silver? Are worldly yellow and white things worthy of being used to fool this immortal master?"
Above the cellar, the eyes of the Liu family's children were full of disgust.
He didn't even bother to look at the two old guys. His eyes fell on Lin Xiaowan's beautiful face, and the evil fire in his heart instantly rose:
"Tsk, tsk, I didn't realize that there could be such a watery baby among the mortals. It would be nice to take it back and use it as a concubine's toy."
He laughed obscenely, raised his right hand, and a ray of gray mana turned into an illusory Qi hand and grabbed Lin Xiaowan.
Lin Xiaowan looked at the enlarging giant hand and closed her eyes in despair.
In his mind, Lin Yuan's back when he left two days ago suddenly appeared.
"Brother Yuan..."
However, at the moment when the giant magic hand was about to touch the corner of Lin Xiaowan's clothes.
“Buzz——!”
